title: Constitutional Autonomous Convergence Prover
arc: Arc III — Autonomous Constitutional Intelligence (ACI) Meta-layer
description: Aggregates multi-cycle evidence across the full 5-module ACI pipeline (CASL+CADE+CAPE+CAOE+CALI) and computes cryptographic convergence proofs demonstrating whether the autonomous governance system is IMPROVING, STABLE, or DEGRADING. DEGRADING proofs require HUMAN-0 acknowledgement (CACP-HUMAN0-0). Every proof carries an HMAC-SHA-256 binding of all cycle inputs (CACP-PROOF-0). ConvergenceLedger is HMAC-chained append-only.
world_first: First autonomous AI governance system to produce cryptographic proof-of-convergence across a complete multi-stage constitutional intelligence pipeline, with HUMAN-0 gated DEGRADING trend acknowledgement.
